summary: Iteration 140: Magnitude-path retirement evaluation, Digest preview modal, Terminal Mode polish, Admin duplicate-button audit. All 33 backend tests passed (14 new + 19 regression). Frontend verified: Terminal Mode with splitters, double-click reset, status bar; Admin MLHealthStrip with R-adoption card; Admin tabs switching works correctly.

integration_issues.issue: The UserWorkspace modal (containing DigestToggle with 'Preview & send' button) is not accessible from the current UI. The 'My Workspace' menu item navigates to the workspace view instead of opening the modal.
integration_issues.note: Backend endpoints /api/digest/my-preview and /api/digest/send-now are working correctly. The modal component exists but needs a UI trigger.

action_items: Add UI trigger to open UserWorkspace modal (currently 'My Workspace' navigates to workspace view instead of opening the modal containing DigestToggle)
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/tier3-progress correctly returns r_adoption.history[] with {at, r_eligible_frac, r_skipped_frac, samples} and verdict with {threshold:0.7, required_consecutive:3, consecutive_stable_runs, latest_r_eligible_frac, magnitude_retirement_ready, runs_tracked}
GET /api/digest/my-preview correctly returns content_summary, preview (overview_headline, top_predictions[3], top_smart_money[3], alert_titles[3]), email, generated_at - available to ALL authed users
MLHealthStrip renders 6 cards including new R-weighting adoption card with percentage, sparkline, and verdict copy
Terminal Mode splitters use pointer events (pointerdown/pointermove/pointerup), 1.5px wide bars with grip dots on hover, double-click resets to default (52/55)
Terminal status bar shows 'Layout modified' + Reset button when splits are non-default
Admin panel 12 tabs all switch correctly with scoped refresh and close button working

success_rate.frontend: 95% - Terminal Mode, MLHealthStrip, Admin tabs all working. UserWorkspace modal not accessible from UI.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 140 complete. New features: (1) r_adoption block in tier3-progress with history and verdict for magnitude retirement evaluation, (2) /api/digest/my-preview endpoint for user-level preview, (3) MLHealthStrip R-adoption card, (4) Terminal Mode with pointer events, double-click reset, status bar Reset button. One issue: UserWorkspace modal (containing DigestToggle with Preview & send button) is not accessible from UI - the modal component exists but needs a trigger.

terminal_mode.status_bar: shows 'Layout modified' + Reset button when dirty
terminal_mode.touch_support: touch-none class prevents mobile scroll interference
